_doc: SPOILER. A confrontation (people spec §11, §21.3; build item N-7.6.7). Rules in scripts/game/confront.gd; the format in docs/systems/story.md.
title: Pell, about the lamps

statements.text: I was at my stall all evening. Ask anyone.
statements.press: Selling oil. Lamp oil, on Lantern Night. Where else would I be?

statements.text: My oil's as good as the Guild's. Better. Cheaper.
statements.press: I buy where I can. I sell where I can. That's a stall.

statements.text: All right. I went up to the lamp. I touched the coupling to steady myself. The crowd was pushing.
statements.press: Just to steady myself. That's all.

statements.text: Whatever you think I did, I did it for nobody. Nobody but me.

evidence.name: Mira, who saw him at the coupling
A flask of his oil, with a grey bloom in it

breaks.text: Pell: Mira. (He laughs, and it goes wrong halfway.) Mira sees everything. She lights the lamps.
Pell: (He won't look at the flask.) Put it away. Please. Put it away.
Pell: You heard that. (His hand goes to his mouth.) Nobody was meant to hear that.
Pell: Don't. Don't say them. (He holds his forearm against his chest as if it hurt.)

won: Pell sits down on an oil crate, all at once, like a man whose strings were cut.

closes.text: Keep quiet, for one thing he knows
